item: The update check and the consent popup name settings that could not be read, instead of protected mode with no usable proxy (follows R766/R769)
summary: The update check refused by an unreadable store answers code settings_unreadable with R766's sentence and way out (was protected_no_proxy, 'Protected mode has no usable proxy'). transport_summary marks a transport read from the environment alone (mode_unknown) with stored: unreadable; the consent popup's lane lines, hovers and hint then name the unreadable settings and never say protected mode is on; the install and update lanes say the install itself is refused (R766). What is refused is unchanged. 6 strings x12. Release line: When the app's settings cannot be read, the update check and the go-online popup now say so, instead of saying protected mode is on or has no usable proxy.
